key.original: CUDA 13.0.1：排查该主题时，有人声称“CUDA Graph只是把相互依赖的kernel无条件同时启动。”，根据文档这个说法哪里需要纠正？
key.english: CUDA 13.0.1: When investigating this topic, someone claimed that "CUDA Graph just unconditionally launches mutually dependent kernels simultaneously." According to the documentation, where does this statement need to be corrected?
